copy.Sonlu elemanlar analizi, modal titreşim,: Finite element analysis, modal vibration, thermal expansion and topology optimization: when analysis is required, what outputs to expect, how the process works.
copy.Tasarım kararlarını doğrulamak için FEA,: We describe the role and typical project flow of FEA, vibration, thermal, and mitigation analyzes to validate design decisions.
copy.Mühendislik analizi, tasarım kararlarını: Engineering analysis is used to verify design decisions with the laws of physics and numerical methods. In parts with high prototype costs or limited testing opportunities, analysis makes the risk visible at an early stage. Different areas of physics, such as stress, deformation, vibration modes, thermal behavior or mass optimization, are addressed with different types of analysis.
copy.Analiz çıktısı her zaman “evet/hayır” ce: Analysis output is not always a “yes/no” answer; It is used to compare design alternatives, identify critical areas, and guide the measurement or test plan. Proper scope definition increases both time and interpretability by avoiding unnecessary detailed modeling.
copy.Sonlu elemanlar analizi (FEA) ne zaman g: When is finite element analysis (FEA) required?
copy.FEA, parça veya montajın yük altındaki g: FEA is applied to numerically evaluate the stress, displacement and safety margin of the part or assembly under load. Model and boundary conditions are established according to static load, impact, fatigue or joint behavior scenarios. Material data, loading conditions and support definitions directly affect the result quality.
copy.Analiz öncesi netleştirilmesi gerekenler: What needs to be clarified before analysis: which load scenarios, which acceptance criteria (material limits, customer specification), which delivery format (report, screenshot, approved PDF). Once the scope is clarified, a time and resource plan is created.
copy.Modal analiz, yapının doğal frekans ve t: Modal analysis determines the natural frequency and vibration modes of the structure; Used to assess the risk of conflict with external stimulation frequencies. Rotating machine elements, carrier constructions and precision assemblies frequently benefit from this analysis.
copy.Termal genleşme analizi, farklı sıcaklık: Thermal expansion analysis examines stress and displacement in parts and connections at different temperature profiles. Material match, connection type, and operating temperature range are model inputs. In both types of analysis, a confirmatory measurement or comparison with a test is recommended whenever possible.
copy.Kafes (lattice) yapılar ve generative de: Lattice structures and generative design / topology optimization aim to preserve functional constraints while reducing weight and material usage. When combined with additive manufacturing, design freedom increases; If there are traditional machining constraints, the optimization is limited accordingly.
copy.Optimizasyon projelerinde üretim yöntemi: In optimization projects, production method, tolerance and cost constraints should be included in the model from the beginning. Otherwise, a theoretically efficient geometry cannot be produced in the field or it will cause problems in assembly.
copy.Analiz projesi nasıl yürür?: How does the analysis project work?
copy.Tipik akış: gereksinim toplantısı, CAD v: Typical flow: requirements meeting, CAD and material data acquisition, model preparation, solution and result interpretation, report delivery. The need for revision is evaluated together with the design change. Our Ankara-based team shares the technical reporting standard at the beginning of the project within the scope of analysis and calculation service.
copy.Analiz sonrası imalat veya prototip aşam: If the manufacturing or prototype stage is to be carried out after the analysis, the process can be coordinated from a single source with our production consultancy and capacity network.
copy.Yük senaryoları ve kabul kriterlerinin t: Definition of load scenarios and acceptance criteria
